notes:
EBB Table Service 0.1.75-rc

Adds collapsible Settings > Updates with background launch checks, dedicated APK-only GitHub distribution, approved downloads and Android installation. Updates require matching package, newer version, checksum and the existing installed signing certificate.

Send to Kitchen and Send to Cashier remain visible on collapsed order cards in My Orders, Table Orders and Kitchen Pickups. Existing submission/ownership/locked-order rules still control whether each action is enabled.

Adds search Reset, visible Skip remaining options, inline single secondary actions, and horizontal-first wrapping options. Appearance and Sounds includes tablet notification sounds, preview and optional vibration. Environment contains independently confirmed Test Kitchen Print and Test Kitchen Display actions using persistent test identities and explicit DO NOT PREPARE labelling.
